title: Lifting a configuration over another configuration
statement: Let $e$ inject the Boolean alphabet into $\Gamma$, and let $x$ be a $\Gamma$-input and $x'$ a Boolean input of equal length. Given a $\Gamma$-configuration $D$ on $x$ and a Boolean configuration $c$ on $x'$, form a configuration on $x$ whose state, input-head position, and work-head positions are those of $c$ after lifting its symbols through $e$. At each work-tape cell, use the contents of $D$ if the contents of $c$ there equal those of $D$ after decoding through $e$; otherwise use the lifted contents of $c$. Its output is the output of $D$ followed by the lifted output of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean and $\Gamma$ inputs of equal length
